title: Evaluate the full Gaussian heat-collision form with both endpoints
statement: For finite-mass Maxwellian profiles with actual particle numbersn_i,commonTheta anddistinctdrifts,massweightedheat changesTheta toTheta+2tau. WithN=n1+n2,exact E_s=(3N/2)(1-s)(2/Theta)^s pi/sin(pi s),0<s<1,by integrating log(1+2tau/Theta)tau^-1-s with vanishing endpoints. The accepted physical pair identity B_(ij,k)(tau)=2tau/(Theta+2tau)int alpha Fq_k² gives the convergent collision form C_s=-s(1-s)/2 sum c_ij int B tau^-1-s=-s(1-s)(2/Theta)^s pi/sin(pi s)D=-(2s/(3N))E_s D. The integrand is O(tau^-s) near0 andO(tau^-1-s) at infinity. This is an instantaneous exact benchmark at these profiles,not nonlinearGaussian invariance,arbitrary-data differentiation or a favorable sign theorem for all product densities. Taking absolute values before integrating centers would lose the exact cancellation despite physical pointwise posterior negativity.
